title: MKP IR 3
description: The one IR the mkp compiler writes and every target runs: MKP 0.3, checked and lowered. No Markdown is left in it. This schema is the source of the Rust and TypeScript types.

module.description: One build: the document (or pack) with the parts of core and of the given packs it uses, checked and lowered, ready to run.

mkp.description: The version of the compiler that wrote it.

module.description: `doc` for a document, or the pack's name.

levels.description: Every level the page needs: the union of its calls'.

level.description: A level a target has (page 6): core.draw draws the extern widgets, core.live holds variables and runs events, core.gfx draws the canvas widgets. A target lists the ones it has, and a call, a widget or a page lists the ones it needs: none means its Markdown is enough.

needs.description: Every extern the page uses, by who supplies it. A target checks the list when it mounts the page.

core.description: core's externs, supplied by the target: widgets, fns and channels.

app.description: The document's own channels' fns and values, supplied by the app when it mounts the page.

oneOf.description: The document's one `$state` block.
A top-level `let`: a constant, or a value worked out again when what it reads changes.

name.description: A declaration's full name: its pack, a slash, its name (`core/date`, `doc/task`). A fn on a type adds a dot and the fn's name (`core/list.some`).

oneOf.description: A type alias: another name for a type. A contract written after the alias's name adds to its own (`core/int` is `core/number` with step 1).

name.description: A declaration's full name: its pack, a slash, its name (`core/date`, `doc/task`). A fn on a type adds a dot and the fn's name (`core/list.some`).

same.description: The fn `==` and `!=` call, when the record's pack writes one. Left out, records compare field by field.

name.description: A declaration's full name: its pack, a slash, its name (`core/date`, `doc/task`). A fn on a type adds a dot and the fn's name (`core/list.some`).

ordered.description: Its cases carry nothing, so they are ordered as written.

token.description: A token type: an enum whose cases stand for values of one type.

name.description: A declaration's full name: its pack, a slash, its name (`core/date`, `doc/task`). A fn on a type adds a dot and the fn's name (`core/list.some`).

value.description: The type of the value each case stands for.

values.description: Each named case's value, from the tokens blocks of the build. A target may give its own.

name.description: A declaration's full name: its pack, a slash, its name (`core/date`, `doc/task`). A fn on a type adds a dot and the fn's name (`core/list.some`).

fns.description: The names of its fns. A call of one is sent to the fn of the value's own type.

fn_decl.description: A fn written in MKP. One with no return type is an action.

name.description: A declaration's full name: its pack, a slash, its name (`core/date`, `doc/task`). A fn on a type adds a dot and the fn's name (`core/list.some`).
A declaration's full name: its pack, a slash, its name (`core/date`, `doc/task`). A fn on a type adds a dot and the fn's name (`core/list.some`).

default.description: The default body, run when the supplier gives none.

oneOf.description: An extern fn: native to every target (core's), a pack's, or the app's.

name.description: A declaration's full name: its pack, a slash, its name (`core/date`, `doc/task`). A fn on a type adds a dot and the fn's name (`core/list.some`).

oneOf.description: An extern block: values the app gives and fns MKP calls.

name.description: A declaration's full name: its pack, a slash, its name (`core/date`, `doc/task`). A fn on a type adds a dot and the fn's name (`core/list.some`).

supplier.description: Who supplies an extern: the target (core's), the pack that declares it, or the app (a document's channels).

name.description: A declaration's full name: its pack, a slash, its name (`core/date`, `doc/task`). A fn on a type adds a dot and the fn's name (`core/list.some`).

markdown.description: What it writes as Markdown when nobody supplies it, or when the target only writes Markdown. Left out for Markdown's own blocks, which write themselves.

levels.description: The levels drawing this widget needs: core.draw, or core.gfx for the canvas widgets.

expose.description: Fns the app may call, answering the extern channel of the same name.

name.description: A declaration's full name: its pack, a slash, its name (`core/date`, `doc/task`). A fn on a type adds a dot and the fn's name (`core/list.some`).

reads.description: What it reads, as in a binding; empty for a constant.

field.description: A record's field, a widget's input or own variable, or a `$state` field.

require.description: A rule, checked whenever a value it reads changes.

type.description: A type. `name` is a built-in type (`core/number`, `core/list`, …), a declared one (an alias among them), a type parameter (capitals), or `fn`, `record` or `any`, which use the parts that follow.

returns.description: For `fn`; left out when it returns nothing.

contract.description: What narrows a type. Every part that is given has to hold.

bounds.description: Both ends are included; a missing one is open.

expr.description: An expression. Values are expressions too.

oneOf.description: A record made; its rules run when it is made.
An enum's or a token's case, with its values.
A token, by its name. A target draws it with its own value.
A token made from a plain value, through its case that carries one: `stroke.PX(2.5)`.
Inline Markdown, already parsed: a `core/rich_text`.
A literal with holes: a text when `type` is `core/text`, a `core/template` otherwise.
A view as a value: a description of a call, drawn where it is placed.
A prop worked out by a binding.
A call of a fn held in a value.
A value shown as text, as a hole shows it.
Where a `mut` argument writes.
The value, or `none` when one of its contracts or rules fails.

op_name.description: An operator, by its symbol. `-` with one argument negates; `?` takes a condition and two values.

call.description: A call of a fn by its full name: one written in MKP, an extern, or an interface's, which goes to the fn of the value's own type.

get.description: A read of something by name.

oneOf.description: A local, a parameter or a loop variable.
An input of the widget the code is in.
A widget's own variable.
A field of the document's `$state`.
A top-level `let`, by its full name.
A named token: `core/space.S`.
A slot of the widget the code is in.
A value of an extern channel: `core/page.width`, `doc/scores.unit`.

place.description: Where a write goes: a root and a path of fields and items.

value.description: TEXT and CODE: the text; MATH: the `core/latex`; NOTE: the mark; VIEW: the view.

stmt.description: A statement of a fn, a handler or a rule.

oneOf.description: A local.
`over` is a list, a range, or for `mut for` a place.
An action.
An action held in a value.

template.description: A widget written in MKP, lowered: its view as nodes. The document's own view is the template `doc`.

name.description: A declaration's full name: its pack, a slash, its name (`core/date`, `doc/task`). A fn on a type adds a dot and the fn's name (`core/list.some`).

cells.description: Its own variables, each with its starting value.

markdown.description: Its markdown block, lowered onto core's extern Markdown blocks; built from the view for a document's widget that has none. Empty when it writes nothing.

levels.description: The levels this widget needs wherever it is called: its own variables need core.live, and it needs every level its view's calls need.

node.description: A node of a template's view.

extern.description: An extern widget, drawn by the target.

levels.description: The levels this call needs (page 6), its slots' included.

fallback.description: Its Markdown, for a target without its level or without the widget.

levels.description: The levels this call needs (page 6), its slots' included.

key.description: Rows of a list follow their items; rows of a range are keyed by their number.

place.description: A view value or a slot, drawn here.

binding.description: A prop that isn't constant: its value, and everything it reads.

handler.description: What runs when an event fires.
